user.description: Pick a Home Connect appliance. Any appliance can send Notify when home; ovens with programme controls also run presets.

init.description: Planning, safety and notifications. Starting always needs confirmation; aborting never does.

data.abort_on_door_open: Abort if the door is left open
data.door_min_setpoint: Only when the setpoint is at least
data.require_home: Only start when someone is home

data_description.preheat_minutes: Used to work backwards from a ready time. The actual run waits for the real temperature.
data_description.max_total_minutes: The preset aborts and powers the appliance down after this, whatever step it is on.
data_description.door_grace_seconds: Long enough to put food in after preheating.
data_description.notify_persons: These people get a phone notification from the Home Assistant app as well as the appliance's own beep, but only while they are home.

notify.title: Notify when home
notify.description: Notify when home: chosen people get a phone notification from the Home Assistant app as well as the appliance's own beep, but only while they are home.

run.name: Run preset
run.description: Start a preset now, at a time, or so that it is ready at a time.

start_at.name: Start at
start_at.description: When to start. Leave empty to start now.

ready_at.name: Ready at
ready_at.description: When the food should be ready; the start time is worked out backwards.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Must be true: this starts a physical appliance.

abort.name: Abort preset
abort.description: Stop the scheduled or running preset and the appliance programme.

device_id.name: Appliance
device_id.description: The appliance the preset runs on.

steps.name: Steps
steps.description: Ordered list of steps: kind (timed, preheat, hold), program, setpoint, duration_minutes, timeout_minutes.
